coverage.prePairFailure: A fully observed target throw before pair-enter may be joined-complete without target-pair, pair promises or pair closes.

coverage.otherPromises: Do not require all other selected promise settlements for coverage complete. A missing handler observation does not prove physical pending work or drain.
coverage.ancestors: Include every relevant observed ancestor abort/first-close. Complete does not require all ancestors to have closed; absence means unobserved, not open.
coverage.meaning: Complete means declared focus observation coverage through cut only. No global causal, no business completion, no native drain and no cryptographic private identity authentication.
